title: Annual anti-fascist march opposing Lukov March in Sofia
location: Garden beside the Sofia History Museum; central Sofia streets
threshold_50_evidence: AUBG Daily body reports approximately 100 participants; this supports a turnout above 50 while the exact count and estimation method remain uncertain (BG2102-S012).

start_date.summary: AUBG Daily body dates the demonstration to Saturday, February 13, in its report published February 18, 2021.

location.summary: BNR and BNT identify the march in downtown/central Sofia; AUBG Daily also places it in Sofia.

scope.summary: The opened reports describe a local march in Sofia; no other city action established.

organizer.summary: AUBG Daily names Anti-Fascist Bulgaria (ANTIFA BG) as the organizer.

demands.summary: At the demonstration, activist Mihail Mishev criticized the government’s response to antisemitism and racism and opposed allowing fascists into government; the article reports the crowd responding to the speech. This supports a political behavior/process demand directed to the national government.

participants_original.summary: AUBG Daily reports approximately 100 participants; exact count/method not given.

participants_min.summary: No precise numeric lower bound can be set from an approximate estimate.

participants_max.summary: No precise numeric upper bound can be set from an approximate estimate.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: AUBG Daily reports approximately 100 participants, which is direct body evidence consistent with the 50-person threshold; count remains approximate.

end_date.summary: AUBG Daily says the anti-fascist demonstration had ended hours before the later Saturday-afternoon action against BNU. This supports the same calendar-day end (February 13), but gives no exact ending time.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; no event-specific violence finding in read scope.

state_response.accommodation.summary: Unknown for the anti-fascist demonstration; no accommodation toward its organizers is reported.

state_response.arrests.summary: Unknown for the anti-fascist demonstration; no event-specific arrest is reported.

state_response.beatings.summary: Unknown for the anti-fascist demonstration; no event-specific beating is reported.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: The later municipal order and police separation described by AUBG Daily concern the separate BNU Lukov March after the anti-fascist demonstration ended; do not code this as a response to E002. Event-specific response for E002 remains unknown.

state_response.ignore.summary: Unknown; silence is not coded as ignore.

notes: AUBG Daily body dates the event February 13 and reports approximately 100 participants organized by ANTIFA BG. It records a political demand against fascists entering government, voiced in an activist speech during the event, supporting proposed inclusion under political_behavior_process. BNR and BNT also describe a Sofia march under the “No Nazis on Our Streets” theme. AUBG Daily says the anti-fascist demonstration had ended before Sofia municipality ordered BNU to disperse and police separated the later BNU Lukov March groups. Keep that action separate; no response to E002 is coded. Proposal remains pending coordinator and official-baseline review.
open_questions: Can an independent report corroborate the approximately 100-person estimate?
What event-specific state response or protester violence, if any, occurred during the anti-fascist demonstration?
Do BNR, BNT, and AUBG Daily accounts refer to the same physical march, as the current descriptions suggest?
